reply.text: I need to see what you did today before I can say much about it. Nothing is logged yet for today. When you log the workout, I can tell you what I think. But in general: a high-rep burnout set hits the arms hard — that heavy pump and that tired feeling are part of the work. Your muscles fill with metabolites and fatigue accumulates fast. That's the point of a burnout. If you mean something beyond the normal fatigue — numbness, tingling, sharp pain — that's a question for a doctor or physio, not me.
